diffuseAlbedo.note: A first colour for Dark iron glaze (brown-black): no measured colour was read: a first value read from trade and museum photographs of the named material.

refractiveIndex.source: Sang et al. 2025, npj Heritage Science s40494-025-01630-0: glass phase of a Longquan high-temperature glaze 1.500 (after Pagliari et al. 2013)
refractiveIndex.derivation: Transferred from the same family of high-fired lime-alkali silicate glazes
refractiveIndex.note: Not measured on an iron-black glaze. At about 5 to 8 % Fe2O3, oxide additivity suggests about +0.02, giving roughly 1.52, which is the old value. Keep an uncertainty of about +/-0.03.

porosity.note: A glaze is glass: it has no open pores.

wettingDepth.note: The depth whose pores govern the face's look when wet.

grain.note: The finest structure the face shows.

bed.note: The coarsest structure the face shows.

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock surfaces, as the travertine's.

toneSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(albedo) across one face.

roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness) across one face.
